notes.title: Patch Note 20230510
notes.notes:
[b]Update[/b]
[olist]
[*] Character’s maximum level increase to 45
[*] New class "Witch Doctor" unlocked
[*] Main quests "Golden Plains" and "Arid Wilds" unlocked
[*] The Mother's Day event "Mom's Pink Daisy" is now available. During the event period "2023/05/10 (Wed)~05/24 (Wed)", defeat legions in various locations for a chance to obtain the item "Pink Daisy". Collect enough "Pink Daisy" to exchange them for a special colored Alpaca mount with the event NPC. For more details, please visit the event NPC "Lucia (308,398)" in Aven.
[*] The Mother's Day event "Assistant Teren's Flower" is now open. During the event period "2023/05/10 (Wed) ~ 05/24 (Wed)", players level 30 and above can go to Aven and find the NPC "Assistant Teren (308, 392)" to receive the "Floriculture Part". After using the Floriculture Part, players can receive it again every 2 hours of being online, with a chance to obtain the "Pink Daisy" and limited costumes.
[*] Adjust "Hanga's Weeding Gloves", adding an effect trigger cooldown time of 15 seconds.
[*] Fixed the issue where some players experienced no response after entering their account information and password during login.
[*] Remove the option to receive territory salary for level 85 in all towns and cities. It will be reopened after future adjustments.
[*] Fixed the issue where players would receive a random negative status effect when leaving the dungeon.
[*] Fixed the issue where players could not directly teleport to other guild towns while inside a guild town.
[/olist]



[b]Eden Crystal[/b]
1. 5/10 after maintenance ~ 5/17 before maintenance, the first and second layers of Eden Crystal will be guaranteed to transform upwards.
